sentences.text: Samrath Kashyap S/o Late Bhursu Ram Kashyap Aged About 27 Years Caste- Madiya R/o Dhuragaon Dengpara Thana Lohandiguda, Distt. Bastar, C.G. ... Applicant versus 1. State Of Chhattisgarh Through Thana Kodenar Distt. Bastar, C.G. ...
Non-Applicant For Applicant : Mr. Santosh Bharat, Advocate For State : Mr. Ajay Kumar Pandey, Govt. Advocate (Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge) Order on Board 14/08/2024 1.

Applicant has filed this second bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 for grant of regular bail as he was arrested in connection with Crime No. 67 of 2023 registered at Police Station Kodenar, Distt. - Bastar (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 376 (2)(n), 294 & 506 of I.P.C.,
1860.
2.

Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that, victim lodged report in the concerned Police Station alleging that applicant, on the pretext of marriage, has established physical relation with her, also kept her along with him in different place and later on, victim came to know that applicant is already a married person and was also having children.
Thereafter, complaint was lodged when victim was carrying pregnancy.
Based on the report, aforementioned crime was registered against applicant and he was arrested on 01.09.2023.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has not committed any offence.
He has been falsely implicated in the aforementioned crime.
During trial, victim has now been examined and has not supported the case of prosecution.

Applicant is in jail since 01.09.2023,
hence, he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for applicant.

However,
he submits that submission of learned counsel for applicant based on deposition of victim is subject Samrath Kashyap vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143906860/

entities.text: Samrath Kashyap vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 matter of appreciation by learned Trial Court.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

6. Taking into consideration facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegation, submission of counsel for the respective parties, without commenting on merits of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the applicants on bail.
7. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail, upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that - a) Applicant shall appear before the Trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) The applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.

Sd  Sd/-
 (Parth Prateem Sahu)
